speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific nature of the pain and swelling in your left knee, and tell me if you have experienced any trauma or if you have a history of similar symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient reports increasing pain and swelling of the left knee over 2 months. Describes the pain as severe enough to awaken him from sleep on several occasions. States he tried taking ibuprofen with no relief. No family or personal history of significant illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JIA) or Reactive Arthritis (though onset at 24 years old is less typical for JIA, it's a consideration; Reactive Arthritis often presents with monoarticular involvement). Given the severity and lack of response to NSAIDs, further workup is needed.

REQUEST TEST: Rheumatoid Factor (RF), Anti-CCP, Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR), C-Reactive Protein (CRP).
REQUEST TEST: Knee_Xray.
REQUEST TEST: Knee_Ultrasound.
